bib.title: LONGWRITER: UNLEASHING 10,000+ WORD GENERATION FROM LONG CONTEXT LLMS

question: Why do long-context LLMs fail to generate outputs beyond about 2,000 words, and can long-output SFT data fix it?
hypothesis: The output length limit is due to the scarcity of long-output examples in SFT data ('one can only speak as long as one has read').
contributions: Analysis of generation length limits (bounded by SFT output length)
AgentWrite plan-then-write pipeline for building long-output SFT data (LongWriter-6k)
Scaling output window to 10,000+ words; DPO further helps; LongBench-Write benchmark

method.summary: Probe output length limits with LongWrite-Ruler, show SFT max output length caps generation, build LongWriter-6k with GPT-4o AgentWrite (plan then sequential paragraph writing), SFT GLM-4-9B and Llama-3.1-8B on it plus 180k general SFT, then DPO on LongWriter-9B. Evaluate on LongBench-Write with length score and GPT-4o quality score.

datasets.name: LongWriter-6k
datasets.source: 3,000 instructions from GLM-4 SFT data (mostly Chinese) + 3,000 from WildChat-1M (mostly English), selected by GPT-4o; responses by AgentWrite with GPT-4o
datasets.preprocessing: rule-based filtering of toxic and scraping instructions; ~0.2% removed (too short or too many plan steps); 'paragraph n' identifiers removed; >95% of selected instructions manually verified as needing thousands of words

datasets.name: GLM-4 chat SFT subset
datasets.preprocessing: for pilot study filtered to max output 500/1000/2000 words (72/98/99.9% kept)

datasets.name: GLM-4 chat DPO data
datasets.preprocessing: for each instruction sample 4 outputs from LongWriter-9B, score per Hou et al. 2024 plus length score Eq.1; best = chosen, random one of other three = rejected

datasets.name: LongBench-Write
datasets.source: authors' collected user prompts; avg input 88, avg required output 2,772, median 1,550 words

models.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o mini, GLM-4-9B-chat, Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct, Mistral-Large-Instruct, Suri-I-ORPO

training.objective: SFT with token-averaged loss, packing training with loss weighting (Bai et al. 2024a); then DPO

other.dpo_hyperparameters: follows Hou et al. 2024; lr, beta not stated
other.loss_averaging: per token across batch, not per sequence

inference.max_tokens: 32k (LongWrite-Ruler open models); 32,768 (LongBench-Write open models); API maximum for proprietary
inference.samples: one output per prompt; no seeds stated
inference.prompting: AgentWrite plan prompt then per-paragraph write prompt with prior text

other.NLL test: ~100 outputs >8,192 tokens by 3 LongWriter models, using GLM-4-9B and Llama-3.1-8B

metrics.name: Sl
metrics.definition: 100*max(0,1-(l'/l-1)/3) if l'>l; 100*max(0,1-(l/l'-1)/2) if l'<=l; words (chars for Chinese)

metrics.name: Sq
metrics.definition: GPT-4o judge mean over six dimensions (Relevance, Accuracy, Coherence, Clarity, Breadth and Depth, Reading Experience), 1-5 integers, length ignored

baselines: proprietary and open-source models in Table 3
eval.protocol: single run, GPT-4o judge (self-judging bias acknowledged), manual pairwise win/loss for GPT-4o and 3 LongWriter models

prompts.text: I need you to help me break down the following long-form writing instruction into multiple subtasks. Each subtask will guide the writing of one paragraph in the essay, and should include the main points and word count requirements for that paragraph. ... each subtask's paragraph should be no less than 200 words and no more than 1000 words. Do not output any other content.
You are an excellent writing assistant. I will give you an original writing instruction and my planned writing steps. I will also provide you with the text I have already written. ...

evidence.quote: We use a batch size of 8, a learning rate of 1e-5, and a packing length of 32k.

results.claim: Maximum output length of GLM-4-9B tracks the longest outputs in its SFT data (cap 500/1000/2000 words gives about 600/900/1,800 words).
results.setup: GLM-4-9B base, 180k GLM-4 chat SFT data filtered to max output 500/1,000/2,000 words (72%/98%/99.9% of data); LongWriter-Ruler test.

results.claim: All tested models (4 open, 4 proprietary) cap at about 2k words on LongWrite-Ruler.
results.quote: the maximum output length of all models is around 2k words

results.claim: AgentWrite extends GPT-4o output from 2k to about 20k words.
results.quote: AgentWrite successfully extends the output length of GPT-4o from a maximum of 2k words to approximately 20k words

results.claim: Length score Sl on [4k,20k) rises from 0 to 80.3 when LongWriter-6k is added to GLM-4-9B SFT.
results.setup: LongBench-Write 120 prompts; LongWriter-9B vs '-LongWriter-6k data' (general SFT only).
results.table: Table 4, rows LongWriter-9B and -LongWriter-6k data, column [4k,20k) Sl

results.claim: Overall quality Sq rises from 77.1 to 82.3 with LongWriter-6k data.
results.setup: LongBench-Write all 120 prompts, GPT-4o judge, GLM-4-9B.
results.table: Table 4, rows LongWriter-9B and -LongWriter-6k data, column Overall Sq

results.claim: DPO raises overall score from 80.5 to 84.0 (Sl +4%, Sq +3%).
results.setup: LongWriter-9B vs LongWriter-9B-DPO on LongBench-Write; DPO data = ~50k GLM-4 chat DPO + 4k long-writing pairs, 250 steps.
results.quote: DPO significantly improves both Sl (+4%) and Sq (+3%) scores
results.table: Table 3, rows LongWriter-9B and LongWriter-9B-DPO, column Overall S

results.claim: Humans prefer DPO model over LongWriter-9B in 58% of cases; DPO model ties GPT-4o.
results.setup: Manual pairwise annotation on LongBench-Write outputs.
results.quote: humans prefer the DPO-trained model over LongWriter-9B in 58% of the cases

results.claim: Plan-augmented SFT data does not significantly help: Sl slightly up, quality down.
results.setup: GLM-4-9B, plan prepended to LongWriter-6k outputs.
results.note: Overall S 81.4 is above LongWriter-9B 80.5; Sl 80.9 vs 78.6, Sq 81.8 vs 82.3.
results.table: Table 4, row w/ Plan-augmented data, columns Overall S, Sl, Sq

results.claim: Instruction-backtranslation data (6k) fails to extend length or quality.
results.setup: GLM-4-9B, 6k pretraining texts 2k-32k words with GLM-4-Long instructions.
results.table: Table 4, row w/ Backtranslation instr., column [4k,20k) Sl

results.claim: Quality for outputs >=4k words: AgentWrite parallel hurts Coherence (-6%) vs sequential.
results.setup: GPT-4o with AgentWrite sequential vs parallel.
results.quote: it impairs the output quality of AgentWrite, especially in terms of Coherence (-6%)

results.claim: LongWriter-9B-DPO outscores all proprietary models in overall S.
results.table: Table 3, row LongWriter-9B-DPO, column Overall S

results.claim: LongWriter models' maximum generation is between 10k and 20k words; fewer than 100 training samples exceed 20k words.
results.quote: there are less than 100 data points with output lengths of 20k words or greater

results.claim: Over 1% of WildChat prompts request outputs above 2,000 words.
results.quote: over 1% of user prompts explicitly request outputs exceeding this limit

limits: Authors: LongWriter outputs max 10k-20k words; longer needs more long-output SFT data.
AgentWrite outputs occasionally contain minor repetitions and summarization.
GPT-4o is generator and judge (self-judging bias noted for GPT-4o row).
Single run, no seeds or variance; 120-prompt benchmark; DPO optimizer and beta not stated.

terms.definition: plan-then-write divide-and-conquer pipeline producing long outputs with off-the-shelf LLMs
